title: On the nature and origin of complexity in discrete, homogeneous, locally-interacting systems
relevance: Introduces the concept of logical depth — the time required by a near-optimal program to produce a string — as a measure of organized complexity. Provides the theoretical foundation for distinguishing structured from random Collatz trajectories.

title: On the Complexity of Finite Sequences
relevance: Defines the LZ76 complexity measure for finite sequences and proves its asymptotic relationship to entropy rate. This is the core algorithmic tool for computing trajectory complexity in the compression-guided search framework.

title: The similarity metric
relevance: Introduces the normalized compression distance (NCD) as a practical approximation to the normalized information distance. Applicable to clustering Collatz trajectories by shared algorithmic structure without domain-specific feature engineering.
